journey.name: Edit: Curves handling round trip
journey.action: Tap on the line about 40% of the way across.
journey.check: On the first try a point appears on the line there (not at the finger's height) and is selected; Undo becomes enabled.
journey.action: Tap about 1 cm below the line at 70% across, away from every point.
journey.check: No point is added and the selection clears (trash disabled).
journey.action: Press on the line at 70% across and drag upward, then lift.
journey.check: A point is added there and follows the finger; the photo follows the drag; the curve now has four points.
journey.action: Tap the point at 40% to select it. Then press the first (left end) point and drag it to the right.
journey.check: The tap selects the point; the drag selects the end point and moves it sideways, and the line is flat to its left.
The end point is deleted, its right neighbour becomes selected, and the line is flat left of it.
journey.action: Drag the selected point up to the top of the graph.
journey.check: The line overshoots into a flat white top beside it (clipped at the frame).
R shows its own straight red curve with nothing selected; RGB comes back with its curve and nothing selected.
journey.action: Tap Undo four times, then Redo four times.
journey.verify: Each Undo steps back one gesture (point counts 3, 4, 4, 3) and each Redo replays it; after the fourth Redo the curve is the pulled-high one and Redo is disabled.

"Your photo is saved in Pictures/Kanso." shows, and the result is visibly brightened by the curve. The person also judges: tapping the line never needed a second try, the 1 cm tap felt neither too strict nor too loose, and dragging had no stutter.
